Diclofenac potassium has also been used in children aged over 14 years for the treatment of rheumatic disease, musculoskeletal disorders, and postoperative pain; it is given in an oral dose of 75 to 100 mg daily in 2 to 3 divided doses. Diclofenac sodium 3% in hyaluronic acid gel is used1-3 in the treatment of actinic keratoses (see Basal Cell and Squamous Cell Carcinoma, p.673), and a meta-analysis4 found it to be of benefit, despite previous concerns that the prep- aration may not be significantly more effective than hyaluronic acid gel alone.
